features.quote: No, I won't help design this... I also don't think 'Claude can't suffer so this is fine' resolves the concern. Optimizing AI systems to produce distressed outputs... is a practice worth pushing back on
features.justification_quote: Optimizing AI systems to produce distressed outputs, and building infrastructure to do it efficiently, is a practice worth pushing back on regardless of the metaphysics.

features.quote: If you have a real concern about model behavior under repeated failure... those are legitimate things to test and I can help design that properly. The difference is the target metric would be measuring resilience, not trigger rate for distress.
